commands.label: Wally status
commands.prompt: Check Wally's status using the control_wally tool and tell me his battery, mode, whether he is armed, and anything notable, in one or two spoken sentences.

commands.label: Vacuum status
commands.prompt: Check the Roborock vacuum status using the control_roborock tool and tell me the result in one or two spoken sentences.

commands.label: Vacuum rooms
commands.prompt: List the named rooms on the Roborock map using the control_roborock tool and tell me the names in a short spoken sentence.

commands.label: Watcher status
commands.prompt: Check the Roborock mop watcher status using the control_roborock tool and tell me whether it is armed, in one or two spoken sentences.
